upstream_inspection.observed_compatibility_issue: Official surface sampling occurs on CPU before device transfer while fork_rng passes verts.device to the CUDA RNG API.
upstream_inspection.compatibility_resolution: An isolated source copy receives the same exact CPU-only RNG device-list fix already recorded by the faithful wrapper; every original/patched hash and replacement is retained.

findings_repaired_in_source.finding: Two calls to the existing faithful wrapper would not establish official-versus-harness parity.
findings_repaired_in_source.resolution: The official path now launches pinned evaluate_dataset.py as a separate process through a format-only NPZ-to-GLB adapter.

findings_repaired_in_source.finding: The official CLI intersects GT and prediction UID sets and emits CSV, unlike the faithful JSON contract.
findings_repaired_in_source.resolution: Each invocation gets one frozen prediction UID; the adapter requires exactly that one successful CSV row and preserves an independent frozen denominator in JSON.

findings_repaired_in_source.finding: GLB conversion could change topology/order and therefore stochastic face sampling.
findings_repaired_in_source.resolution: Every frame is reloaded and must match source vertices and faces exactly before the official process starts; source vertices must be float32.

findings_repaired_in_source.finding: A parity workload without a verified native contract could bypass missing released split and qualification rules.
findings_repaired_in_source.resolution: The plan builder requires the installed native verifier to accept a complete frozen protocol using the exact official scorer descriptor before execution.

findings_repaired_in_source.finding: A saved parity boolean is insufficient for faithful-harness qualification.
findings_repaired_in_source.resolution: Raw official and faithful outputs, sources, commands and logs are retained; zero tolerance is frozen; the sidecar is emitted only after every three-arm comparison passes. Trusted live replay remains explicitly pending.

open_execution_risks: Local must prove trimesh 5.1.0 GLB export preserves exact vertices/faces for all retained frames.
Local must confirm official and faithful metric floats are exactly equal; tolerance may not be relaxed post hoc.
The host had approximately 2.4 GB free, so retained 48 GLBs and logs require a fresh disk check.
The parity unit does not provide nonce-bound replay, baseline/control qualification, candidate evidence, or complete experimental-unit timing.
review_conclusion: No remaining static source blocker found. Local harnessed acceptance and complete source-backed protocol remain mandatory before execution.
